description: Presidential Secretariat - Hon our able Sathasivam Viyalendiran, State Minister of Trade Resigned with Effect From June 24,2024. Appointed Sathasivam Viyalendiran Member of Parliament with Effect from June 24,2024.
categorisation: This gazette content contains only government personnel changes (resignation and appointment of a named individual, Honourable Sathasivam Viyalendiran) with basic titles ("State Minister of Trade" and "State Minister of Trade and Environment"). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, which would be required for a Hybrid (Type 3) classification.
